# Licences of the breengel suite's test data

Everything under `testdata/breengel/` is installed on the test disk at
`/usr/local/test/share/breengel/` (`scripts/create_ext2_disk.sh`).

| Path | What it is | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `fonts-corpus/` | 64 malformed TrueType files and `index.txt`, generated by `tools/font-corpus/generate.py` from literal tables written for this repository; no glyph or table comes from a published font | no third-party content: generated in-tree data, redistributed with the repository on the same terms as its source |
| `fonts/compound-transform.ttf` | a valid TrueType font with one compound glyph using each component transform, generated by the same script from literal tables | no third-party content: generated in-tree data, redistributed with the repository on the same terms as its source |
